points.text: WEBSTEP AS is registered as aksjeselskap (AS) based in Oslo, registered under 'Dataprogrammeringstjenester', founded 1986-12-19.
What it does (per its website): Webstep er et teknologihus med pålitelig, fleksibel og erfaren ekspertise med nye IT løsninger. Vi er en trygg og erfaren samarbeidspartner.
Latest filed accounts (2025): revenue 835.2M NOK, operating result 77.4M, net result 68.9M; revenue down 4% vs 2024 (calculated).
Leadership: Daglig leder: Anne Kristine Lund; Styrets leder: Anne Kristine Lund.
5 registered workplace(s): Bergen, Kristiansand, Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim.
Verified website: https://webstep.no/ (organisation number on the site the company declared to an official source (in page markup)).
Recent official register changes: 2026-09-15 registered employees; 2026-08-13 registered employees; 2026-07-16 registered employees.
